units: INR crore except share counts, per-share INR, ratios and rates

source_notes.lease: Annual note48 confirms financing lease payment contains principal and lease interest. Deduct payment once, do not additionally deduct P&L lease interest.
source_notes.growth_capex: All-capex cash is not maintenance free cash flow. Unit VI is a growth project.
source_notes.tax: Current H1 tax is zero and P&L tax is deferred. Forward model uses 25% normalized cash tax instead of assuming perpetual zero tax.
source_notes.project_budget: Issuer total1500 and roughly250 already spent. Not decomposed for future capitalized interest. Working1250 is an explicit non-interest capex assumption, tested at1100 for possible interest/budget overlap. This is not a verified non-interest bill of quantities.
source_notes.timing: Annual MD review printed10 says Dec2029, printed11 says late2030. Rating July2026 says Dec2029. Working case allows first meaningful new-plant EBITDA only in fifth year.
source_notes.capacity: Issuer FY26 narrative gives468000TPA, ICRA around500000TPA following debottleneck. Do not infer exact utilization from a rounded denominator.
source_notes.current_investments: FY26 note9 shows equity investments. Forward model credits current portfolio at75% of Sep carrying value. No noncurrent investments or other bank balances credited.
source_notes.funding: Debt model assumes refinancing and project borrowing remain available, no contractual facility closure was verified. Borrowing authority and a credit rating are not committed project funding. No dilution is assumed only within scenarios, not guaranteed.

model.periods: Five model years from decision, approximate operating/funding periods, not issuer fiscal guidance
